input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us as Licensee only, running three years past termination and covering every person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates. Both the 36-month duration and the all-personnel scope fall in the playbook's walk-away zone (over 24 months / all Vendor personnel). The clause does already contain an acceptable general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out and no "no-hire", so rather than delete the provision outright (preferred position) we narrowed it to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, twelve months post-termination, and limited to personnel directly involved in the activities under the Agreement. The related injunctive-relief reference in p0126 remains workable once the covenant is mutual.

proposal.summary: Make non-solicit mutual, cut term to 12 months, and limit scope to personnel directly involved in the Agreement
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We can accept only a narrow, time-limited non-solicit, so we have made this mutual, shortened the tail from three years to twelve months, and limited it to personnel directly involved in this Agreement; a three-year restriction covering every Licensor and Affiliate employee is outside our position. The existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out is unchanged.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance or receipt of the activities contemplated by this Agreement to leave his or her employment with such other party.
